name: email
description: Send email over SMTP and read, flag and move messages over IMAP (Gmail, Outlook or any provider) with an app password

nodes.title: Verify email connection
nodes.description: Check that the SMTP and/or IMAP settings and password work: connects, logs in and disconnects. Sends nothing and changes nothing.

protocol.description: Which server to check; "both" checks every server that is configured

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send email
nodes.description: Send an email over SMTP from EMAIL_FROM. At most 50 recipients per message; every recipient counts toward the daily cap (EMAIL_DAILY_SEND_LIMIT). Never retried automatically. As an agent tool: only recipients in EMAIL_TOOL_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS (refused when unset) and no attachments.

to.description: Recipients, separated by commas: budi@example.com, "Sari W" <sari@example.com>

text.description: Plain-text body. Pass text, html or both

html.description: HTML body. Pass text, html or both

in_reply_to.description: Message-ID being answered (from read_message.message_id), for threading

references.description: Message-IDs of the thread, separated by spaces (from read_message.references plus its message_id)

attachments.description: Files to attach (workflow nodes only; refused for agent tool calls): [{"source": "https://... or /absolute/path inside EMAIL_ALLOWED_FILE_DIRS", "filename": "optional.pdf", "content_type": "optional/type"}]. Up to 18 MB in total.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List email messages
nodes.description: List messages in a mailbox, newest first, with sender, subject, date, flags and a short text snippet. Filters: unseen only, since a date, sender, subject text.

mailbox.description: Mailbox (folder) path as shown by list_mailboxes, e.g. INBOX or "[Gmail]/Sent Mail"

since.description: Only messages received on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD; IMAP compares whole days)

from.description: Only messages whose From contains this text

subject.description: Only messages whose subject contains this text

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Read email message
nodes.description: Read one message by UID: headers, Message-ID and References for replying, the body as plain text (HTML converted to text, never rendered) and attachment metadata (attachments are not downloaded).

mailbox.description: Mailbox (folder) path as shown by list_mailboxes, e.g. INBOX or "[Gmail]/Sent Mail"

mark_seen.description: Also set the \Seen flag (otherwise the message stays as it is)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List mailboxes
nodes.description: List the account's mailboxes (folders) with their special use (\Sent, \Trash, \Junk, ...), optionally with message and unseen counts.

include_counts.description: Also return message and unseen counts (one STATUS per mailbox)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Mark email seen
nodes.description: Set the \Seen flag on messages by UID (mark as read). UIDs that do not exist are listed in missing_uids.

uids.description: Message UID, or several separated by commas (at most 100), from list_messages

mailbox.description: Mailbox (folder) path as shown by list_mailboxes, e.g. INBOX or "[Gmail]/Sent Mail"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Mark email unseen
nodes.description: Clear the \Seen flag on messages by UID (mark as unread). UIDs that do not exist are listed in missing_uids.

uids.description: Message UID, or several separated by commas (at most 100), from list_messages

mailbox.description: Mailbox (folder) path as shown by list_mailboxes, e.g. INBOX or "[Gmail]/Sent Mail"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Move email
nodes.description: Move messages by UID to another mailbox (e.g. an archive folder or "[Gmail]/Trash"). Returns the new UIDs when the server reports them. Needs a server with the MOVE or UIDPLUS extension.

uids.description: Message UID, or several separated by commas (at most 100), from list_messages

mailbox.description: Mailbox (folder) path as shown by list_mailboxes, e.g. INBOX or "[Gmail]/Sent Mail"

destination.description: Target mailbox path as shown by list_mailboxes

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
